usageNotes: Returns the current status of the cluster QDevice (quorum device), which is a lightweight tie-breaker service used to provide quorum in two-node Proxmox clusters. Call this to verify whether the QDevice is reachable and vote-contributing before maintenance or node reboots. Requires the QDevice to have been previously configured via corosync; the response will be minimal or error-like if no QDevice is configured.

examples.summary: Check QDevice status on a two-node cluster

tips: A two-node cluster without a QDevice has no quorum majority — losing one node brings the whole cluster down. This endpoint lets you confirm the QDevice is actively contributing a vote before taking a node offline.
If the cluster was never configured with a QDevice, this endpoint typically returns an empty object or a state indicating 'not configured' rather than an error.
The QDevice process runs on an external lightweight host (e.g., a small VPS or Pi); confirm that host is reachable at the network level if this call returns a degraded state.
